Title: Retainers - effect on Pulled Fangs, Bombs etc...?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <dhoffman.5...@cris.com>,
Daniel Hoffman <dhof...@cris.com> wrote:
>Does damage done by retainers count towards damage done at close range for the
>purpose of Pulled Fangs? I don't think so but they are weapons of a sort so it
>is iffy.

No.

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: Pulled Fangs
Date: 4 Mar 1995 20:20:33 GMT
Message-ID: <3jai2h$m...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

Pulled Fangs just cares about the range the round is at, not the nature
of the damage inflicted upon the vampire whose fangs are to be pulled.
So a shotgun will do just as well as a chainsaw. Note that damage from
retainers such as Wolf Companion won't count when comparing damage
inflicted.

>If a ghoul retainer used a Zip Gun, Grenade or Bomb is the ghoul considered
>the bearer or is the vampire? The Zip Gun won't kill the retainer but the
>Grenade or Bomb will unless they damage the vampire instead. I would think
>that the ghoul retainer takes the damage.

!!WARNING - Educated Guess Follows - WARNING!!

While that may make more sense in the game world, it complicates things too
much for a card game. The Zip Gun's use will cause damage to it's bearer - and
the Ghoul is not the bearer; the vampire takes the damage. The Grenade and Bomb
are the same - damage the vampire (if at close for the grenade).

Tangent discussions used for basis of opinion:

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: DESIGN TEAM RULINGS: 5/9/95
Date: 9 May 1995 07:17:48 GMT
Message-ID: <3on4us$l...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

4) "Can my Ghoul Retainer keep firing my Sawed-Off Shotgun over
and over during a combat?"
No. The ghoul is actually using the weapon in question, and
must follow all the normal rules for using it. Also, you cannot
have your vampire and its ghoul fire the shotgun at the same time.

>A familiar theme:
>Can multiple X be played and are they cumulative?
>X:

As written, this works, though I'm pretty sure the intention is that a given
weapon only be used by one minion/ally/retainer each round (see also the
rules on stealing equipment).
